slice: RPP-5kt selected 3-to-2 removal from a consumed MLINESTYLE
scope: Generalizes consumed MLINESTYLE removal admission to a nonempty ordered survivor subsequence and qualifies AC1027 three-element-to-two-element removal for each possible deleted tuple. Admission does not qualify every source/target count, native semantics or whole-document support.

references.use: Group 73 is the MLINESTYLE element count; group 74 gives the repeated parameter count per vertex; group 41 contains parameter values and group 75/42 the area-fill counts and values.
Group 49 carries each MLINESTYLE element offset.

contract.admission: The runtime-authored AC1027 source has three style tuples: offsets [1.25,-0.75,-1.25], ACI [1,3,4] and linetypes [ByLayer,Continuous,ByLayer]. Two source-bound ordinary MLINEs consume it. Each test removes one tuple, preserving the ordered two-element survivor sequence. Style flags are 2 and start/end angles match. All source dictionaries, style identity/provider joins and both consumer records are bound by the existing source capture and planner.
contract.geometry: The consumers are open, uncut, unfilled, three-vertex MLINEs with finite positive scale, center/bottom justification, unit extrusion and source-consistent positions, directions, miters and per-vertex parameters. Projection retains each survivor's source parameter slot and recalculates group 41 against the target minimum. Removing the minimum offset exercises bottom-justification rebasing. Each emitted parameter pair is [value,0], group 42 is absent and group-75 counts are zero.
contract.identityAndOutput: All three possible removed positions pass for ASCII/binary input crossed with ASCII/binary output. The output proof checks style group 71=2, exact group-49 offsets, flag and element group-62 colors, group-6 linetypes, and unique ByLayer/Continuous LTYPE provider records and their table ownership. Both MLINEs retain their original redundant group-2 name and point group 340 at the emitted style; group 73=2, group 74 counts, group 41 parameter arrays, group 75 zeros and absent group 42 are checked. Fresh import verifies tuple identity, consumer arrays, vertices, directions, miters, scale, extrusion and justification.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing the style flags to an unsupported value refuses before publication and preserves destination/caller state; correcting the flag allows same-adapter retry. A late consumer-parameter mutation refuses before publication; restoring the caller snapshot allows same-adapter retry. Both failure classes run with ASCII and binary output.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. The source profile is generated locally at runtime and temporary drawings are deleted after a passing run; no test fixture is committed.
contract.limits: Only AC1027 source count 3 to target count 2, each deletion position, and the exact open/uncut/unfilled consumer profile are qualified. Other source/target counts, empty-style output, unused-definition edits, other MLINE carriers/schemas/versions, native CAD rendering, document closure and independent 3D semantics remain unqualified. No format-support claim is promoted.

controls.removalAndProjection: Each of the three source element positions is removed. Output projection is checked against each survivor tuple and the full target minimum, including the target-minimum change when the -1.25 tail element is removed.
controls.failureAndRetry: Twelve successful encoding/deletion profiles; sixteen successful readbacks including corrected retries; two invalid-flag refusals and two late-consumer mutation refusals preserve destination/caller state; four same-adapter retries succeed.
